2122649962710175974.en_summary: T. Rowe Sticks to Bearish Treasuries Bet That Fueled Banner 2026. Betting on UK gilts and against US Treasuries since early 2026 is paying off for T. Rowe Price’s Scott Solomon, who isn’t in any hurry to unwind those wagers. His co-managed $800 million Dynamic Global Bond Fund is up around 5% so far this year, beating 97% of peers and on track for its best annual performance since 2020. Underpinning that return was a basic conviction: That the US economy would keep outpacing other economies, putting pressure on Treasuries. “We’ve stuck with the view of strong growth in the US and not quite as good growth in the rest of the world,” Solomon said.
2122649962710175974.zh_summary: T. Rowe堅持看淡國債的押注，推動了出色的2026年。自2026年初押注英國金邊債券並做空美國國債，為T. Rowe Price的Scott Solomon帶來回報，他不急於平倉這些押注。他共同管理的8億美元Dynamic Global Bond Fund今年迄今上漲約5%，跑贏97%同行，有望創2020年以來最佳年度表現。支撑這一回報的基本信念是：美國經濟將繼續超越其他經濟體，給國債帶來壓力。「我們堅持美國強勁增長、世界其他地區增長不那麼好的觀點，」Solomon說。

2122649449331646567.en_summary: Behind Nvidia’s rise to a $5 trillion company was a culture of put-downs, parties and a “royal family,” according to a new Wall Street Journal investigation. Jensen Huang was known inside the company for being demanding and difficult, and so was his daughter, Madison. She was one of two adult children he brought into the business, along with his son, Spencer. By January, Madison’s husband, Nico Caprez, had become a vice president, pushing financing deals that turned cash-strapped data center builders into long-term Nvidia customers. Publicly, Huang credited his success to his wife, Lori. Inside Nvidia, his temper was legendary. He reportedly once told a top executive, “I hope you die and put us all out of our misery.”
2122649449331646567.zh_summary: 根據《華爾街日報》新調查，Nvidia崛起為5萬億美元公司的背後是貶低、派對和「皇室家庭」的文化。黃仁勳在公司內部以要求高且難相處聞名，他的女兒Madison也是如此。她是他帶入業務的兩個成年子女之一，連同兒子Spencer。到1月，Madison的丈夫Nico Caprez已成為副總裁，推動融資交易，將現金緊張的數據中心建設商變成Nvidia的長期客戶。公開場合，黃仁勳將成功歸功於妻子Lori。在Nvidia內部，他的脾氣是傳奇。據報他曾對一位高管說，「我希望你死，讓我們所有人脫離痛苦。」
